relations.text: Warintza計画の金ストリームとロイヤルティを2億ドルでRoyal Goldが取得
relations.text_en: Royal Gold bought a gold stream and royalty on its Warintza project for $200 million

source.label: Royal Gold 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We acquired a gold stream and net smelter return royalty for total cash consideration of $200.0 million on the Warintza project located in Southeastern Ecuador.
